name: precursor:mass_tolerance
description: Precursor mass tolerance (+/- around precursor m/z).

name: precursor:mass_tolerance_unit
description: Unit of precursor mass tolerance.

name: precursor:min_charge
description: Minimum precursor charge to be considered.

name: precursor:max_charge
description: Maximum precursor charge to be considered.

name: precursor:isotopes
description: Corrects for mono-isotopic peak misassignments. (E.g.: 1 = prec. may be misassigned to first isotopic peak).

name: fragment:mass_tolerance
description: Fragment mass tolerance (+/- around fragment m/z).

name: fragment:mass_tolerance_unit
description: Unit of fragment mass tolerance.

name: modifications:fixed
description: Fixed modifications, specified using UniMod (www.unimod.org) terms, e.g. 'Carbamidomethyl (C)'.

name: modifications:variable
description: Variable modifications, specified using UniMod (www.unimod.org) terms, e.g. 'Oxidation (M)'

name: modifications:variable_max_per_peptide
description: Maximum number of residues carrying a variable modification per candidate peptide.

name: peptide:min_size
description: Minimum size a peptide must have after digestion to be considered in the search.

name: peptide:max_size
description: Maximum size a peptide may have after digestion to be considered in the search.

name: peptide:missed_cleavages
description: Number of missed cleavages.

name: peptide:enzyme
description: The enzyme used for peptide digestion.

name: peptide:clip_nterm_methionine
description: Also search protein N-terminal peptides after removal of their initial methionine (the form with the methionine is still searched). Generated decoys keep the initial methionine, so that targets and decoys gain the same peptides. Set false for the previous search space.

name: report:top_hits
description: Maximum number of top scoring hits per spectrum that are reported.

name: report:xl_fdr_groups
description: Separate FDR group for short cross-links (at most 9 residues, nucleic acid adduct of at least 2 nucleotides). They carry little sequence-specific fragment evidence next to their adduct, so with one FDR over all cross-links far more of the short ones are false. In their own group, the FDR of the short and of the other cross-links is each held at report:xlFDR (annotated as NuXL:fdr_group). 'auto': only if the short cross-links have at least 10 decoys at 10% FDR over all cross-links, enough to estimate their own FDR. 'on': whenever the short and the other cross-links both have decoys. 'off': one FDR over all cross-links.

name: NuXL:presets
description: Set precursor and fragment adducts from presets (recommended). Custom presets can be defined in a 'nuxl_presets.json' file placed in the share/OpenMS/NUXL/ directory or specified via NuXL:presets_file.

name: NuXL:length
description: Oligonucleotide maximum length. 0 = disable search for NA variants.

name: NuXL:sequence
description: Sequence to restrict the generation of oligonucleotide chains. (disabled for empty sequence).

name: NuXL:target_nucleotides
description:
format:  target nucleotide=empirical formula of nucleoside monophosphate 
 e.g. A=C10H14N5O7P, ..., U=C10H14N5O7P, X=C9H13N2O8PS  where X represents e.g. tU 
 or e.g. Y=C10H14N5O7PS where Y represents tG.

name: NuXL:nt_groups
description: Restrict which nucleotides can cooccur in a precursor adduct to be able to search both RNA and DNA (format: 'AU CG').

name: NuXL:mapping
description: format: source->target e.g. A->A, ..., U->U, U->X.

name: NuXL:can_cross_link
description: format: 'U' if only U forms cross-links. 'CATG' if C, A, G, and T form cross-links.

name: NuXL:standalone
description: Target nucleotides that only form precursor adducts on their own (e.g. 's' for a cross-linker without nucleotide). They are never combined with other nucleotides and are not restricted by NuXL:sequence. They need a NuXL:target_nucleotides entry, NuXL:modifications and NuXL:fragment_adducts, and must be listed in NuXL:can_cross_link. Hits with only standalone nucleotides count as peptides, not cross-links (FDR and reports), and are not searched with NuXL:only_xl.

name: NuXL:localization
description: How cross-links are localized. 'fragments': at the residue the shifted fragment ions point to. 'NHS': for cross-linkers attached through an NHS ester (e.g. SDA), by its chemistry among the residues the fragment ions can't tell apart: the free protein N-terminus, then lysine, then S/T/Y with a histidine within four residues, skipping residues with a modification other than a pure isotope substitution (e.g. Acetyl (K) or TMT6plex (K), but not Label:13C(6) (K)) and, if the enzyme cleaves after lysine, a C-terminal lysine unless the peptide ends the protein; otherwise unlocalized. Reports how the site was chosen in NuXL:localization_method and the supported residues in NuXL:localization_range.

name: NuXL:fragment_adducts
description: format: [target nucleotide]:[formula] or [precursor adduct]->[fragment adduct formula];[name]: e.g., 'U:C9H10N2O5;U-H3PO4' or 'U:U-H2O->C9H11N2O8P1;U-H2O'.

name: NuXL:modifications
description: format: empirical formula e.g U:  U:-H2O, ..., U:H2O+PO3.

name: NuXL:scoring
description: Scoring algorithm used in prescoring (fast: total-loss only, slow: all losses).

name: NuXL:rescoring
description: Additional evidence per hit, after ProSE. 'features': annotate the score margin over the best hit of another peptide sequence (NuXL:delta_score, and NuXL:delta_score_class within cross-links or peptides; needs slow scoring) and a fragment ion likelihood learned from the confident hits of the run (NuXL:ion_llr, NuXL:ion_llr_shifted, NuXL:ion_explained, NuXL:ion_topk_observed; needs decoys), and pass them to Percolator. The hits of each half of the spectra are scored by the ion model trained on the other half. 'native': in addition, add the delta score of cross-links and 0.3 times NuXL:ion_llr to the score of every hit, which ranks the hits and is reported in the idXML, the TSV report and the FDR filtered outputs (needs decoys).

name: NuXL:decoy_factor
description: Ratio of decoys to targets.

name: NuXL:CysteineAdduct
description: Use this flag if the +152 adduct is expected.

name: NuXL:filter_fractional_mass
description: Use this flag to filter non-crosslinks by fractional mass.

name: NuXL:carbon_labeled_fragments
description: Generate fragment shifts assuming full labeling of carbon (e.g. completely labeled U13).

name: NuXL:only_xl
description: Only search cross-links and ignore non-cross-linked peptides.

name: NuXL:filter_small_peptide_mass
description: Filter precursor that can only correspond to non-crosslinks by mass.

name: NuXL:marker_ions_tolerance
description: Tolerance used to determine marker ions (Da).

name: filter
description: Filtering steps applied to results.

name: window_size
description: Peak window for spectra precprocessing.

name: peak_count
description: Retained peaks in peak window.
